product_naming: The product UI labels the deliverable an 'asset' and the destination the 'Simulated Attacks Library' (Custom Assets tab). 'Template' and 'asset' refer to the same object.
flows: Create New Asset — Generate with AI
Create New Asset — Upload EML File
Asset Library (Custom Assets tab, empty, view-only)

creation_modes.surface: Single Create New Asset page with three tabs (not a modal chooser)
tabs: Generate with AI — prompt + prompt chips + motive, AI generates
Create Manually — blank WYSIWYG, no AI, full control
Upload EML File — start from a real .eml, optional screenshot

key_fields: Prompt to generate email + prompt chips (IT helpdesk / Finance / Custom)
Select motive (Authority, Urgency, etc. — matches Library Motive column)
Body (WYSIWYG with Add Phishing Link + Add QR code + Insert variable)
Difficulty (Easy / Medium / Hard) — pre-generation input, default Medium
add_phishing_link_subflow: 1 — Select display text in body; Add Phishing Link is the next action
2 — Anchored popover: Link text, Landing destination, read-only Tracked simulation URL + trust note; Cancel / Insert link
3 — Inserted as a tracked-link token with a badge + confirmation 'routed through a safe simulation URL'
add_variable_subflow: 1 — Cursor in body; click the 'Insert variable' ({ }) toolbar control

2 — Anchored menu: search + plain-English variables grouped Recipient/Location/Company (First name, Last name, Email, Job title, Office location, Mailing address, City, Company name, Department) with sample values and a per-variable fallback note
3 — Inserted as an atomic token chip (not free text); Preview renders it filled with sample data. Foolproof: no hand-typed merge-tag syntax; missing values fall back to a default
open_questions_flagged: Should screenshot-based generation (OCR + layout reconstruction) be P0 or P1?
Should multilingual output be supported at launch?
Which metadata should be captured to enhance adaptive-risk scoring?
Should assets be shareable across tenants with governance review?
Raw .eml/screenshot retention, deletion, and training-pipeline-exclusion policy
Does Save produce an immediately deployable (Active) asset, or is deploy a separate gated step downstream?
Downstream behavior when deleting/editing a campaign-linked asset
figma_source: Page 'DUNE 628 - Custom Creation of phishing Assets', section 'AI Phishing Template Generator — Rebuilt Storyboard (2026-07-09)'
confidence_notes: Synced to the as-built rebuilt storyboard (17 frames: 3 creation tabs with setup + edit variants, generating progress, mobile preview, regenerate/delete modals, library empty + view-only states, asset detail deploy-enabled + RBAC-disabled, and the 3-state Add Phishing Link sub-flow). Screen structure, field names, and copy are now observed rather than inferred. Remaining low confidence is on unresolved product questions (retention policy, Active-on-save vs deploy gate, motive/category taxonomy finalization), not on the design.
